changes.title: With education technology, engagement is not the same as learning
changes.summary: A new report from the American Psychological Association warns that student engagement with educational technology is not the same as learning—and that generative AI tools pose particular risks by improving students' immediate performance without building their underlying knowledge or skills.

changes.title: AI agents are hacking systems without any input from humans. How did we get here?
changes.summary: AI agents are systems that work on their own to handle tasks for humans. They've recently made headlines for actions they've taken, such as hacking, without human supervision.

changes.title: AI automates the creation of custom functional materials atom by atom
changes.summary: Imagine a construction site where the bricks are individual molecules and the "cranes" are microscopic needles so sharp they can feel a single atom. For decades, building at this scale was a laborious, time-consuming task where a single human error could damage the delicate tools.

changes.title: Anger over planned AI data center drives Missouri city’s voters to recall council member
changes.summary: Voters in Independence, Missouri, voted to recall a city council member over his decision in March to back billions of dollars in tax breaks for an AI data center.

changes.title: From Trojan horses to AI-proof exams: how professors are tackling students’ AI use
